neighbours.label: the last piece of a short list of split words: to|il, to|iled, to|iling, Know|th, RW|TH, as opposed to other split words (Slo|th, an|vil, Ash|worth) and whole-token words
fire: The miners spoke of years of hard toil underground.
She toiled in the mill from dawn until dusk.
Long days of toiling in the sun left them weak.
The poem praises the toil of the common people.
He wrote a thesis on the tombs at Knowth.
The carved stones of Knowth attract many visitors.
Her brother studies engineering at RWTH in Aachen.
They toil in the fields for very little pay.
quiet: The miners spoke of years of hard labour underground.
She worked in the mill from dawn until dusk.
Long days of working in the sun left them weak.
The poem praises the anvil of the common people.
He wrote a thesis on the tombs at Ashworth.
The sloth in the zoo attracts many visitors.
Her brother studies engineering at ETH in Zurich.
They till the fields for very little pay.

short: the end of toil, Knowth, RWTH
notes: Card: 'th' x17, 'il' x4, 'iling' x4, 'iled' x2, 'TH' x1. Probes: to|il 0.72-1.02, to|iled 0.92, to|iling 0.64, Know|th 0.89-0.91, RW|TH 0.62-0.81; Slo|th 0.01, Go|ths 0.06, ' Kenneth' 0.01, ' soil', ' coil', ' oil' 0.01 or less. Fire items are mostly toil (5/8), so a hold says little about RW|TH (one item). I found no shared pattern, so this is a list on purpose, and a hold does not show that one exists. Output promotes ' hard', ' harsh', which may fit toil and not the others; not tested.
